name: Delney, Streetwise Lookout doubles Runic Armasaur's triggered ability

prerequisites.timing: Whenever an opponent activates a non-mana ability of a creature or land.
other: Runic Armasaur's oracle text: 'Whenever an opponent activates an ability of a creature or land that isn't a mana ability, you may draw a card.' Power is 2, so it qualifies for Delney's power-2-or-less doubling clause.

The ability is a 'may' ability (optional), unlike Esper Sentinel's mandatory-with-opponent-choice or Orcish Bowmasters' mandatory shape - so the choice at stake here belongs to Runic Armasaur's own controller, not the opponent.

MODELING REQUIREMENT for future Layer 5 encoding (per docs/ARCHITECTURE.md Layer 2): each of the two doubled instances is an independent 'may draw' decision for the controller - a player could accept one and decline the other (e.g. to avoid a draw-triggered downside elsewhere in a four-player game). Do not collapse to a single 'may draw 2' choice.

result.summary: Runic Armasaur's opponent-activated-ability draw trigger fires twice per qualifying opponent activation: the controller independently decides, per instance, whether to draw - up to 2 cards instead of 1.

rules_citations: CR 603.2d — an ability may state that a triggered ability triggers additional times; determine how many times, then trigger that many times.
CR 603.3b — a player puts each of their own simultaneously-pending triggered abilities on the stack in any order they choose.

executable_engine_check.notes: Reproduced in the same from-source Maven build of magefree/mage (JDK 21) used for INT-0002/0007/0008/0013, via a new JUnit test, org.mage.test.cards.interactions.cedh.DelneyRunicArmasaurDoubleTest#test_DelneyDoublesRunicArmasaurDraw (not committed to this repo — see docs/RUN_CLASSIFICATION.md and rules_tests/gold_board_states/GBS-0006.json for the fixture record). Test setup: Delney + Runic Armasaur on the battlefield for playerA, Mishra's Factory + Wastes on the battlefield for playerB. playerB activated Mishra's Factory's '{1}: becomes a 2/2 Assembly-Worker' ability (a non-mana activated ability of a land, no target). One trigger-order choice needed, then two independent 'may draw' choices, both accepted. Result: playerA's hand grew from 0 to 2. Passed 1/1 on the first attempt.

sources.reference: Independent pairwise scan of card_cache oracle text against Delney's triggered-ability-doubling clause, 2026-08-12 (not indexed as a formal combo by Commander Spellbook - this is a value multiplier, not a win line).
Scryfall-sourced official ruling on Delney, Streetwise Lookout (2024-02-02): 'Any choices made on resolution... are also made individually.' Supports the independent may-draw decision per instance.
